day5_school_arrive.name: Me
day5_school_arrive.text: *I pass through the school gate. The campus is deserted on a Sunday.*

day5_school_arrive2.name: Me
day5_school_arrive2.text: *This week flew by. Already the last day. The trees in the schoolyard sway gently in the breeze.*

day5_school_arrive3.name: Me
day5_school_arrive3.text: *It was only a few days ago, but it feels like ages. Back then I was nothing but a ball of nerves and anxiety. Now I'm pretty different.*

day5_school_arrive4.name: Me
day5_school_arrive4.text: *I glanced back and saw someone walking toward me from the distance. A familiar silhouette.*

day5_meet_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_meet_seoyeon.text: "This is where we first met, right? You had total lost-transfer-student energy back then."

day5_meet_seoyeon2.name: Seoyeon
day5_meet_seoyeon2.text: "But now you look different. More at ease, I guess. Not a bad change."

day5_react_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_react_seoyeon.text: *Seeing Seoyeon smile warms something in my chest. She was the very first person who talked to me at this school.*

day5_seoyeon_d4_warmth.name: Seoyeon
day5_seoyeon_d4_warmth.text: "...You know. When you held me last night. That alone gave me so much courage. ...Thank you."

day5_seoyeon_d4_warmth_pinky.name: Seoyeon
day5_seoyeon_d4_warmth_pinky.text: "We pinky-promised last night, remember? My fingertip still feels warm. You'd better not forget that promise."

day5_meet_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_meet_yuna.text: "...Here. Do you remember when we first met? ...I do."

day5_meet_yuna2.name: Yuna
day5_meet_yuna2.text: "...When you were standing at the gate, you looked lonely. I was the same way. So I noticed."

day5_react_yuna.name: Me
day5_react_yuna.text: *This is the first time Yuna's ever said this much. Does that mean today is that special to her?*

day5_yuna_d4_warmth.name: Yuna
day5_yuna_d4_warmth.text: "...For holding my hand last night. ...It was warm."

day5_yuna_d4_warmth_ally.name: Yuna
day5_yuna_d4_warmth_ally.text: "...You took my side yesterday. ...I won't forget that."

day5_meet_dain.name: Dain
day5_meet_dain.text: "Being at the front gate reminds me! When we first met! Do you remember when I nailed you with that volleyball?!"

day5_meet_dain2.name: Dain
day5_meet_dain2.text: "I felt SO bad about it at the time... but looking back, I'm grateful for that accident. It's how I met you."

day5_react_dain.name: Me
day5_react_dain.text: *A connection that started with a volleyball to the face— yet now even that accident feels like it was meant to be. Dain's bright smile completely changed my daily life.*

day5_dain_d4_warmth.name: Dain
day5_dain_d4_warmth.text: "...Me crying yesterday is a SECRET!! But... I'm glad I could cry in front of you."

day5_meet_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_meet_nurse.text: "Coming to school on a weekend feels strange somehow. Meeting you at this school... do you think it was fate?"

day5_meet_nurse2.name: Nurse
day5_meet_nurse2.text: "When you came to the nurse's office on your first day, that nervous face was adorable. You've grown up a lot since then."

day5_react_nurse.name: Me
day5_react_nurse.text: *Seeing her in casual clothes is both unfamiliar and exciting. I had no idea she looked this beautiful underneath that lab coat.*

day5_meet_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_meet_teacher.text: "Ha, school on a weekend. But since it's with you, not bad."

day5_meet_teacher2.name: Teacher
day5_meet_teacher2.text: "When I first saw you in the staff room on transfer day, you had such anxious eyes. Now you look like a different person."

day5_react_teacher.name: Me
day5_react_teacher.text: *A compliment from someone who rarely gives them hits differently. Her expression is softer today, too.*

day5_outfit_compliment.name: Me
day5_outfit_compliment.text: (They looked me up and down, eyes going wide. "You look different today?" That comment made me secretly pleased.)

day5_walk_together.name: Me
day5_walk_together.text: "Want to go inside? Lots of places to revisit."

day5_walk_enter.name: Me
day5_walk_enter.text: *We walked into the school side by side. It's Sunday, so the building is empty— only our footsteps echo.*

day5_corridor1.name: Me
day5_corridor1.text: *This hallway. On my first day I wandered here trying to find my classroom. I had no idea where to go and couldn't get my feet to move.*

day5_corridor2.name: Me
day5_corridor2.text: *That's when someone in this hallway spoke to me. One small kindness— and it led all the way to here.*

day5_classroom_enter.name: Me
day5_classroom_enter.text: *I opened the classroom door. Afternoon sunlight slanted in through the windows, dyeing the desks gold.*

day5_classroom1.name: Me
day5_classroom1.text: *My seat. The same one I first sat in when I transferred. Still right there. I sat down again for a moment.*

day5_classroom2.name: Me
day5_classroom2.text: *Looking up at the blackboard from this seat— the same angle as back then. Somehow that's comforting.*

day5_classroom3.name: Me
day5_classroom3.text: "A lot happened in this room. Getting caught dozing off in class and everything."

day5_classroom_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_classroom_seoyeon.text: "Watching you do your introduction, I thought 'This one's not bad.' Call it the student council president's intuition."

day5_classroom_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_classroom_yuna.text: "...Our eyes met here for the first time. I was looking out the window, and when you looked at me... I was startled."

day5_classroom_dain.name: Dain
day5_classroom_dain.text: "We used to stretch in here before gym class! You were SO inflexible lol. Has it gotten any better?"

day5_classroom_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_classroom_nurse.text: "When I came in for a class observation, I noticed you kept glancing toward the nurse's office window. Hehe."

day5_classroom_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_classroom_teacher.text: "Every day I called your name during roll call in this room. Just when it was starting to feel routine... it's already the last day."

day5_memory_spot_suggest.name: Me
day5_memory_spot_suggest.text: "Anywhere you want to go? Let's keep looking around."

day5_memory_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_memory_seoyeon.text: "Hold on— let's check the garden. You know, the flower bed I water every day."

day5_memory_seoyeon2.name: Seoyeon
day5_memory_seoyeon2.text: "Look, all the flowers I planted are blooming. You helped me water them the first time you came here. I think that's when... I knew."

day5_memory_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_memory_yuna.text: "...Wait. Can we go there? The library."

day5_memory_yuna2.name: Yuna
day5_memory_yuna2.text: "...This is where you first sat next to me. When you asked about the book title... I was surprised. Nobody had ever talked to me before."

day5_memory_dain.name: Dain
day5_memory_dain.text: "Wait!! Let's hit the gym!! That's where it all started on day one!!"

day5_memory_dain2.name: Dain
day5_memory_dain2.text: "I was practicing volleyball here and the ball went flying right into your face! Sorry lol! But thanks for not getting mad."

day5_memory_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_memory_nurse.text: "Want to stop by the nurse's office? The memory of your first visit is still fresh."

day5_memory_nurse2.name: Nurse
day5_memory_nurse2.text: "On your first day, you came in saying you had a headache from all the nerves. When I put my hand on your forehead, your face turned bright red. Hehe."

day5_memory_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_memory_teacher.text: "Hold on. Stand in front of the podium. That's where you gave your introduction on transfer day."

day5_memory_teacher2.name: Teacher
day5_memory_teacher2.text: "Your voice was shaking so much back then. I remember thinking, 'This kid... I'm a little worried.' But look how different you are now."

day5_memory_common.name: Me
day5_memory_common.text: *Memories of this place rise from somewhere deep inside. I knew nothing at first, but day by day they built up and shaped who I am now.*

day5_memory_common2.name: Me
day5_memory_common2.text: *Every place holds a memory, and this person was always in it. I know what that means now.*

day5_rooftop_suggest.name: Me
day5_rooftop_suggest.text: "Hey, want to go up to the rooftop? Weather's nice, and the view from up there should be great."

day5_rooftop_stairs1.name: Me
day5_rooftop_stairs1.text: *Climbing the stairs. Two sets of footsteps echo through the empty stairwell. One floor, two floors.*

day5_rooftop_stairs2.name: Me
day5_rooftop_stairs2.text: *The last staircase. We stood before the rooftop door. A breeze slips through the gap.*

day5_rooftop_door.name: Me
day5_rooftop_door.text: *Creak. The door opened to a wide-open sky. Wind brushed my face.*

day5_rooftop_view1.name: Me
day5_rooftop_view1.text: *Was the view from up here always this good? The field, rooftops stretching into the distance, the streets we walked earlier.*

day5_rooftop_view2.name: Me
day5_rooftop_view2.text: *Or maybe it only feels this good because of who's standing next to me.*

day5_rooftop_lean.name: Me
day5_rooftop_lean.text: *We leaned against the railing side by side. The wind tousled our hair.*

day5_rooftop_silence.name: Me
day5_rooftop_silence.text: *For a while we just looked at the view in silence. The quiet wasn't awkward. With this person, it never is.*

day5_rooftop_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_rooftop_seoyeon.text: "I have a dream. After graduation, I want to be someone who works for others. Being on student council made that even clearer."

day5_rooftop_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_rooftop_yuna.text: "...I want to write. I can say in writing what I can't say to people. ...I'd like it if you read my stuff."

day5_rooftop_dain.name: Dain
day5_rooftop_dain.text: "I'm gonna go pro! Compete in nationals and win the whole thing! ...But sometimes I get scared. Like, can I actually do it?"

day5_rooftop_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_rooftop_nurse.text: "My dream was to be a hospital nurse at first. But after looking after kids at school, I realized this is where I belong. And this is where I met you, too."

day5_rooftop_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_rooftop_teacher.text: "When I first became a teacher, I had zero confidence. But meeting kids like you... makes me think I chose the right path."

day5_rooftop_future_talk.name: Me
day5_rooftop_future_talk.text: "Honestly, before I transferred here, I didn't have the luxury to think about the future. I was just getting through each day."

day5_rooftop_feeling1.name: Me
day5_rooftop_feeling1.text: "But that changed after I came here. I started looking forward to tomorrow. Meeting people became something I enjoyed."

day5_rooftop_feeling2.name: Me
day5_rooftop_feeling2.text: *All of that is because of the person beside me. I can't put it all into words yet, but someday, I will.*

day5_lunch_suggest.name: Me
day5_lunch_suggest.text: "Hungry? I grabbed some stuff from the convenience store. Want to eat up here?"

day5_lunch_setup.name: Me
day5_lunch_setup.text: *I pulled out some rice balls and drinks from my bag. Simple, but with this view, it's more than enough.*

day5_lunch_sit.name: Me
day5_lunch_sit.text: *We sat side by side against the shaded wall near the railing. The floor's a bit cold, but the warmth beside me makes up for it.*

day5_lunch_eat1.name: Me
day5_lunch_eat1.text: *One bite of the rice ball. Just a convenience store snack, but today it tastes especially good.*

day5_lunch_talk1.name: Me
day5_lunch_talk1.text: "Eating on the rooftop feels like a picnic."

day5_lunch_talk2.name: Me
day5_lunch_talk2.text: *A quiet laugh from beside me. It drifted away on the breeze, carried off somewhere.*

day5_lunch_talk3.name: Me
day5_lunch_talk3.text: "Before I transferred, eating alone was just normal for me. In the classroom, at home."

day5_lunch_talk4.name: Me
day5_lunch_talk4.text: "I never knew eating with someone could feel this good."

day5_lunch_moment_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_lunch_moment_seoyeon.text: "Same. Student council keeps me so busy I just scarf down food alone. But eating with you... it's like time slows down."

day5_lunch_touch_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_seoyeon.text: *Seoyeon gently rested her head on my shoulder. Her cheeks flushed pink. My heart nearly stopped.*

day5_lunch_moment_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_lunch_moment_yuna.text: "...Same. I thought eating alone was fine. But sitting next to you... the food tastes better."

day5_lunch_touch_yuna.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_yuna.text: *Yuna's hand quietly slid over mine. Her cold fingertips slowly warmed. I gently closed my hand around hers.*

day5_lunch_moment_dain.name: Dain
day5_lunch_moment_dain.text: "When I eat alone I just inhale everything super fast! But with you I eat slowly. Weird, right?"

day5_lunch_touch_dain.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_dain.text: (Dain suddenly grabbed my arm tight. "If you go quiet on me I'll worry!" she said, but she didn't let go.)

day5_lunch_moment_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_lunch_moment_nurse.text: "When you grow up, moments like these get fewer and fewer. That's what makes right now so precious."

day5_lunch_touch_nurse.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_nurse.text: (She pressed the drink can lightly against my cheek. "Cold, right?" she said with a smile more dazzling than the sunlight.)

day5_lunch_moment_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_lunch_moment_teacher.text: "This is my first time eating with a student like this. As a teacher it's a bit... but today, I just want to be here as a person."

day5_lunch_touch_teacher.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_teacher.text: *She smiled and ran her hand lightly over my hair. Her usual strictness— gone without a trace. Only a warm touch remained.*

day5_lunch_after.name: Me
day5_lunch_after.text: *I finished the last of my drink. The can that started cold had gone lukewarm in my hands. That's how much time has passed.*

day5_lunch_cleanup.name: Me
day5_lunch_cleanup.text: *I gathered the trash and tidied up. On the floor where we sat, a sunlit imprint lingered.*

day5_pre_afternoon1.name: Me
day5_pre_afternoon1.text: *The sun has started to tilt. The shadows are shorter than before.*

day5_pre_afternoon2.name: Me
day5_pre_afternoon2.text: *The day isn't over yet. Or rather— there are still words left unsaid.*

day5_pre_afternoon3.name: Me
day5_pre_afternoon3.text: *Something stirs deep in my chest. A signal that the moment to find my courage is getting close.*

day5_pre_afternoon4.name: Me
day5_pre_afternoon4.text: *To the person standing beside me. Today, there are feelings I absolutely have to tell them.*
